summary: On September 8 the City discovered the public hearing notice did not reach 34 properties carrying the SID I-P overlay, representing 19 property owners, due to a mapping error. Revised notice issued September 9; first reading moved to October 6.
notes: Original notice was a Measure 56 mailing to approximately 2,100 owners on August 5, 2026
confidence_note: No inference drawn about legal effect. Oregon notice requirements are not those of any other state.
